sources.snippet: Welcome to the ONNX Model Zoo! The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard format created to represent machine learning models. Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers. sources.title: paddleocr-onnx: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview paddleocr-onnx is a collection of 16 optical character recognition models covering 48+ languages, converted from PaddleOCR to ONNX format for production deployment. Maintained by monkt, the collection includes 11 PP-OCRv5 models (latest generation, highest accuracy) and 5 PP-OCRv3 models (legacy, supporting additional languages like Hindi, Tamil, and Arabic).
